title: Coordenador de Fluxo de Materiais
description:
Atividades:


  • Definir e otimizar o fluxo interno de abastecimento de materiais, do recebimento ao ponto de uso na produção;
  • Mapear processos e identificar gargalos, desperdícios e oportunidades de melhoria contínua;
  • Implementar e sustentar sistemas Kanban e definir parâmetros de abastecimento (lotes, estoque mínimo/máximo e reposição;
  • Estruturar conceitos de armazenamento na linha, garantindo acuracidade de estoque e eficiência operacional;
  • Padronizar rotas e frequência de abastecimento, assegurando estabilidade do fluxo junto às áreas de Produção, Logística, Planejamento, Engenharia e Qualidade;
  • Desenvolver e monitorar KPIs (ruptura de linha, acuracidade, lead time, eficiência de rota e downtime);
  • Liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua (Kaizen, 5S) e treinar equipes nos processos implementados.
  • Realizar demais atividades inerentes à função, atendendo aos padrões de qualidade, saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e eficiência energética estabelecidos pela companhia.


Perfil:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Logística, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida em Melhoria Contínua / Lean Manufacturing e gestão de materiais;
  • Conhecimento avançado em VSM (Value Stream Mapping);
  • Kanban e sistemas puxados;
  • Logística interna e abastecimento de linha;
  • Gestão de estoques e acuracidade;
  • Experiência prática em ambientes industriais;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas ERP (ex.: SAP ou similares) será um diferencial;
  • Inglês Avançado/ Fluente;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em horário comercial.


O que oferecemos.

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Prêmio Assiduidade - Vale alimentação Sodexo;
  • PPR;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Transporte;
  • Alimentação na empresa subsidiada com refeitório próprio.

title: Fullstack Java/kotlin/React Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58277



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor Full-Stack com sólida experiência em Java e Kotlin (backend) e React (frontend) para se juntar à nossa equipe. Esta vaga é ideal para alguém que trabalha bem com pouca supervisão, assume responsabilidades e consegue entregar soluções de alta qualidade de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente para conversação, escrita e leitura pois atenderá a grande empresa dos EUA do setor financeiro.
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • Horário: seg a sex das 10hs as 19hs, seguindo o calendário dos EUA.
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Governanta
description:
VAGA: GOVERNANTA RESIDENCIAL – ALTO PADRÃO

Residência de alto padrão busca Governanta Residencial  para atuação estratégica e operacional, com foco em organização, gestão da rotina doméstica e excelência no padrão de entrega.

 Sobre a função

A governanta será responsável por garantir o perfeito funcionamento da casa no dia a dia, atuando como elo entre família, funcionárias e fornecedores. Espera-se postura profissional, visão de hotelaria aplicada à residência e capacidade de antecipar necessidades.

 Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão da rotina doméstica e acompanhamento das atividades diárias
  • Organização e manutenção do padrão da casa
  • Coordenação e supervisão de funcionárias (babás, faxineiras e demais prestadores)
  • Controle de cronogramas, enxoval, materiais e insumos
  • Interface direta com os proprietários
  • Garantia de discrição, confidencialidade e excelência no atendimento

 Perfil desejado

  • Experiência comprovada como governanta residencial
  • Postura ética, discreta e extremamente profissional
  • Organização, liderança e senso de prioridade
  • Comunicação clara e respeitosa
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alto nível de exigência e padrão
  • Vivência em casas de alto padrão será um diferencial

 Requisitos

  • Referências profissionais comprovadas
  • Disponibilidade para dedicação integral
  • Comprometimento com padrões elevados de qualidade
  • Apresentação pessoal alinhada ao ambiente de luxo residencial

 Oferecemos

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado de alto padrão
  • Ambiente estruturado e profissional
  • Relação de trabalho clara, organizada e respeitosa

 Candidatura

Interessadas devem enviar currículo e breve apresentação profissional. Apenas candidatas dentro do perfil serão contatadas: .

title: Fullstack Java/kotlin/React Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58277



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor Full-Stack com sólida experiência em Java e Kotlin (backend) e React (frontend) para se juntar à nossa equipe. Esta vaga é ideal para alguém que trabalha bem com pouca supervisão, assume responsabilidades e consegue entregar soluções de alta qualidade de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente para conversação, escrita e leitura pois atenderá a grande empresa dos EUA do setor financeiro.
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • Horário: seg a sex das 10hs as 19hs, seguindo o calendário dos EUA.
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $14,000 – $18,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English required, with familiarity in French

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. title: Especialista em Java (Tech Lead)
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar 100% de forma remota, integrando o time de Tecnologia como referência técnica da squad de backend. Será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time, definir padrões de desenvolvimento, promover boas práticas e garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções construídas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Liderar tecnicamente a squad de backend, servindo como referência para o time.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.
  • Definir padrões de código e arquitetura, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções.
  • Realizar code reviews estruturados.
  • Definir backlog técnico e quebrar épicos em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Conduzir refinamentos técnicos e apoiar na priorização de débitos técnicos em conjunto com o PM.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes (unitário e integração) e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento (GitFlow ou trunk-based).
  • Aportar e disseminar conhecimento técnico na squad, evoluindo a maturidade do time.
  • Atuar como elo de contato entre a squad e outras equipes técnicas do Grupo Casas Bahia (Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e SRE).


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Forte capacidade de mentoria e comunicação clara e didática.
  • Capacidade de delegar tarefas conforme a maturidade do time.
  • Liderança pelo exemplo (hands-on) e capacidade de dar feedback construtivo.
  • Organização, disciplina técnica, paciência e facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Agile, Scrum e Kanban.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Java 11 ou superior, Spring Boot e APIs RESTful (OpenAPI / Swagger).
  • Experiência com JPA/Hibernate, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA).
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, SOLID e DDD (Domain-Driven Design).
  • Experiência com Kafka (produção, consumo, particionamento, DLQ, retry).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AKS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SOLR, MongoDB e Redis.


Informações adicionais:


Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.


Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:


  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Programa de Formação de Assessores de Investimentos | Contratação Imediata + Formação ANCORD
description:
Você quer ser Assessor de Investimentos, mas ainda não tem a ANCORD? Nós apostamos no seu talento.

Se o seu sonho é construir uma carreira de alta performance no mercado financeiro, mas você sente que as portas estão fechadas por falta de certificação ou experiência prática, o nosso Programa de Formação é o seu lugar.


Na Vértua, nós não buscamos apenas um currículo; buscamos dedicação, resiliência e vontade de crescer.


Como funciona a trilha do seu sucesso:

- Contratação Imediata: Você entra no time desde o dia 1.

- Formação ANCORD: Nós fornecemos o treinamento e o suporte para você conquistar a sua certificação ANCORD.

- A Escola de Vendas (SDR): Você iniciará como SDR (Sales Development Representative) para criar “casca”, dominar a abordagem a clientes e entender a psicologia do investidor.

- Aceleração de Ganhos: Ao bater suas metas, você dobra seu salário base. Sim, o seu esforço dita o seu ganho.

- Promoção a Assessor: Após a formação e o período de SDR, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes para atuar como Assessor de Investimentos.


O que buscamos em você:

- Foco em Pessoas: Você deve estar ciente de que o dia a dia exige conversar com pessoas.

- Fome de Crescimento: Queremos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e buscam o variável. 

- Goste de investimentos — você não precisa saber o que é um “CDB” hoje.

- Disponibilidade: Para atuação presencial em Cascavel.


O que oferecemos:

- Curso preparatório para ANCORD por conta da casa;

- Plano de Carreira Agressivo: Do SDR à Assessoria de Investimentos em tempo recorde;

- Cultura de Meritocracia: Dobra salarial por performance;

- Ambiente de Alto Nível: Networking com os melhores profissionais do mercado.


Como participar?

Se você tem brilho nos olhos e quer ser um dos grandes nomes do mercado financeiro, Candidate-se agora!

title: Gerente de Cloud
description:
A Aliare está entre as maiores empresas de software para o agronegócio do país. Nascemos no agro e somos especialistas em levar tecnologia para gestão de empresas e propriedades rurais.


Estamos com nossos clientes, pra fazer o campo acontecer. Temos orgulho de ajudar a construir o presente e o futuro do agronegócio. Buscamos um profissional para atuar em nosso time de Cloud como Gerente da área. E aí, vem com a gente?!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O principal objetivo do gerente de cloud é desenvolver soluções para produtos em cloud gerenciar equipe multidisciplinar para execução dos serviços de evolução e sustentação das soluções de acordo com as estratégias da empresa.


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e executar o orçamento de resultado, planejamento e estruturação da área
  • Realizar o acompanhamento financeiro e de resultado da área
  • Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de cloud das soluções, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e segurança
  • Definir políticas de governança, segurança e conformidade para ambientes cloud, garantindo aderência a regulamentações como LGPD e ISO 27001
  • Gerenciar contratos com fornecedores de serviços em nuvem e acompanhar tendências tecnológicas para inovação contínua
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e feedback para os colaboradores diretos
  • Participar do processo comercial das soluções em cloud
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de soluções, desenvolvedores e stakeholders para atender às necessidades dos projetos
  • Estabelecer métricas e indicadores de desempenho para otimizar a performance dos serviços cloud
  • Participar dos processos de contratação de novos colaboradores
  • Apresentar resultados da área


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Formação em TI, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de nuvem: Azure, AWS, OCI e GCP;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias para Cloud: Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernets, Openshift, AKS e afins;
  • Gerenciamento de custos e otimização em infraestrutura Cloud;
  • Vivência com Gestão de Projetos PMI;
  • Participação em Planejamento estratégico de produtos de TI;
  • Orçamento e finanças de TI (FinOps);
  • Domínio em governança de TI;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e DevOps: Scrum, Kanban;
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança e regulamentação: LGPD e ISO 27001;
  • Certificação ITIL ou Cobit será um diferencial;



Habilidades:

  • Liderança Estratégica : Capacidade de inspirar e engajar equipes técnicas na adoção das melhores práticas em cloud computing
  • Gestão de Equipes e Projetos : Coordenação de times multidisciplinares e alinhamento entre equipes de infraestrutura, desenvolvimento e negócios
  • Gestão de Conflitos : Habilidade para mediar e resolver conflitos de maneira eficaz
  • Resolução de Problemas Complexos : Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas complexos de forma eficiente
  • Comunicação Clara e Eficiente : Habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos e stakeholders
  • Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo: Capacidade de acompanhar e implementar novas tendências tecnológicas
  • Visão de Negócio: Compreensão do impacto das soluções cloud nos objetivos estratégicos da empresa
  • Gestão de Tempo e Priorização: Organização para lidar com múltiplos projetos e demandas simultaneamente

Informações adicionais

O que a Aliare proporciona?!

Um time integrado e preparado para novos desafios, que atua com credibilidade e transparência, com objetivo de evoluirmos de forma contínua para facilitar o trabalho de quem alimenta o mundo. Priorizando sempre em nossas ações a ética, o relacionamento, a realização, o comprometimento e inovação.

title: Android Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. Work Schedule:

Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.

  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.

  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.

  • Meticulous attention to detail.

  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:

description:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.

  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.

What a day in the life looks like:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.


What you bring to the team:

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory


You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With


  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)



Why join us?

At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.


We believe the future is better when supply chains work better.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in the workplace.

At Infios, we believe that inclusion is a fundamental cornerstone of our success. We are committed to creating a safe and welcoming environment where every individual’s unique experiences and perspectives are valued—whether they look, think, move, believe, or love differently.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams

  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries

  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily.
